subject: Island 014 Royal Palace interlocked nave-transept naked macro shell

reviewPolicy.hiddenViews: volume-coherence only; source likeness is not scored where the source provides no exact hidden authority

perViewScores.note: The nave/transept family produces a recognizably vertical cathedral with a hero dome and four shoulder domes. The broad plain central front block and separated tower bases still prevent the source's tightly interlocked tapered silhouette.

Closed intersecting volumes survive the oblique transition. Satellites remain visually pillar-like because their bases sit too far outside the nave/transept envelope and their spherical domes dominate their drums.
Hidden side is coherent and load paths remain seated. The keep, nave, and satellites are still readable as adjacent blocks rather than one tightly overlapped cathedral shoulder system.
Least-flattering transition shows genuine closed depth without slab collapse or root slots. The mass is broad and stable but retains isolated corner towers and a rectangular central core.
Rear construction is symmetric and coherent; the apse and cross body read, but tower-to-transept overlap remains weak.
Opposite transition confirms the same real-volume strengths and detached satellite-shoulder weakness.
Opposite side remains coherent with no camera-dependent collapse; rectangular stage boundaries are too explicit for the source's continuous taper.
Front-adjacent view retains the new cathedral hierarchy but confirms that separated tower bases and the broad central front face dilute source likeness.

qualitativeDefectElimination.remaining: The new family has a valid cross-shaped cathedral volume, but its four shoulder towers still read as separate corner pillars and the central front mass is too broad and rectangular.

largestMismatch: The source merges faceted lower body, satellite tower shoulders, and central keep into one continuously tapering silhouette. The blockout has the correct component hierarchy, but the tower BASE/DRUM stages sit too far outside the transept and the keep/nave faces remain broad rectangles, creating a five-block arrangement instead of an interlocked cathedral.

boundedCorrection.falsifiableHypothesis: Moving the four existing BASE/DRUM tower stages inward to overlap the nave/transept envelope while tapering the existing keep and cross-body stage widths will convert the current five-block silhouette into the source's interlocked cathedral shoulders without reducing the proven side/rear coherence.

boundedCorrection.hardRejectThreshold: Retire the family if the corrected worst required score is below 0.75, if worst-score gain is below +0.10, if any critical dimension regresses by more than 0.05, or if any camera-dependent/open-slot/floating-volume veto appears. Approval remains impossible unless every required score reaches 0.85.
